function.description: This API retrieves the list of network devices with their application visibility status. The list can be filtered using the query parameters. Multiple filters can be applied.
function.name: api_retrieveTheListOfNetworkDevicesWithTheirApplication_479dd261

appTelemetryDeploymentStatus.description: Status of the application telemetry deployment on the network device. Available values: SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, NOT_DEPLOYED.

appTelemetryReadinessStatus.description: Indicates whether the network device is ready for application telemetry enablement or not. Available values: ENABLED, READY, NOT_READY, NOT_SUPPORTED

applicationRegistrySyncStatus.description: Indicates whether the latest definitions from application registry have been synchronized with the network device or not. Available values: SYNCING, IN_SYNC, OUT_OF_SYNC, NOT_APPLICABLE

cbarDeploymentStatus.description: Status of the CBAR deployment on the network device. Available values: SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, NOT_DEPLOYED

cbarReadinessStatus.description: Indicates whether the network device is ready for CBAR enablement or not. Available values: ENABLED, READY, NOT_READY, NOT_SUPPORTED

hostname.description:
The host name of the network device.

Partial search is supported. For example, searching for `switch` will include `edge-switch1.domain.com`, `switch25`, etc.

ids.description: List of network devices ids. If this parameter is not provided, all network devices will be included in the response. Multiple network device IDs can be provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

managementAddress.description:
The management address for the network device. This is normally IP address of the device.
But it could be hostname in some cases like Meraki devices.

Partial search is supported. For example, searching for `25.` would include `10.25.1.1`, `25.5.10.1`, `225.225.1.0`, `10.10.10.125`, etc.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values are: asc, desc. Default value is: asc

protocolPackStatus.description: Indicates whether the NBAR protocol pack is up-to-date or not on the network device. Available values: LATEST, OUTDATED, UNKNOWN

protocolPackUpdateStatus.description: Status of the NBAR protocol pack update on the network device. Available values: SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED, NONE

siteId.description: The site ID where the network device is assigned.

sortBy.description: A property within the response to sort by.
